blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems ground large language models (LLMs) by retrieving external evidence and conditioning generation on the retrieved context. Although dense retrieval is effective for local semantic matching, independently ranked retrieval can return redundant passages, miss cross-chunk dependencies, and provide incomplete evidence for multi-hop reasoning. We propose SpectRAG, a spectral graph-augmented retrieval framework that combines hybrid candidate seeding, weighted chunk graph construction, graph-based expansion, spectral relevance propagation, and token-budgeted context selection. Document chunks are represented by dense semantic embeddings and graph-spectral coordinates derived from a weighted chunk graph whose edges encode semantic similarity, document adjacency, section hierarchy, shared entities, citation links, and similarity between LLM-generated utility questions. At query time, SpectRAG builds a high-recall seed set using exact inner-product search and hybrid relevance signals, expands it over the chunk graph, re-scores candidates using graph proximity and spectral information, and assembles the final context under a fixed token budget. The goal is not merely to retrieve individually similar chunks, but to construct a context that is relevant, diverse, structurally connected, and sufficient for grounded reasoning. Experiments on MultiHopRAG, UltraDomain, and long-document question-answering settings show that SpectRAG improves broad evidence recovery and achieves competitive generation quality against dense, hybrid, HyDE, LightRAG, and NaiveRAG baselines. The results further indicate that graph-spectral structure is particularly useful for inference-oriented and cross-document retrieval, while highlighting trade-offs in early precision, computational cost, and domain-dependent performance.
blocks.zh: 检索到的生成(RAG)系统通过检索到外部证据和在检索到的上下文上调节生成来打下大型语言模型(LLMS). 虽然稠密的检索对本地语义匹配有效,但独立排序的检索可以返回冗余的段落,错失了交叉重整的依赖性,并为多跳推理提供了不完整的证据. 我们提议SpectRAG,一个光谱图增强检索框架,将混合候选种子、加权块图构建、以图表为基础的扩展、光谱相关性传播和象征性预算背景选择结合起来。 文档块由密集的语义嵌入和由加权块图所衍生出的图谱谱坐标来表示,其边缘编码语义相似性,文档相接性,节阶,共享实体,引用链接,以及LLM生成的公用问题之间的相似性. 在查询时,SpectRAG利用精确的内出物搜索和混合相关性信号来构建高召种子集,将其扩展至块图上,再用图相相近和光谱信息对候选者进行分数,并用固定符号预算来组装最终上下文. 目标不仅仅是要回收个别的类似块块,而是要构建一个相关、多样、结构相连、足以进行有根据推理的背景。 关于多HopRAG,UltraDomain的实验和长文件的问答设置显示,SpectRAG改进了广泛的证据恢复,并相对于稠密,杂交,HyDE,LightRAG和NaiveRAG的基线,实现了有竞争力的生成质量. 研究结果还表明,图谱结构对于推论导向和跨文件检索特别有用,同时在早期精确度、计算成本和依赖域的性能方面突出取舍。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has become a practical architecture for grounding large language models (LLMs) in external corpora [ 1 ] . In a standard pipeline, documents are chunked, chunks are embedded, a query is embedded, and the top- k k chunks most similar to the query are provided as context to an LLM. Dense passage retrieval [ 2 ] and hybrid sparse–dense retrieval are now widely used because they are scalable and effective for local factual lookup. In this paper, we see this constraint as a separation of two paradigms for retrieval. One of them is the classical top- k k paradigm, where chunks are scored based on their individual similarities to the query, and the top-scoring chunks are selected. The other paradigm is called context-set retrieval, where the goal is to find a set of chunks that, together, provide enough evidence for generation. In this paradigm, a good RAG retriever should not only be able to retrieve chunks similar to the query, but also form a cohesive context set. Nevertheless, the method of extracting the top- k k vectors is subject to three recurring limitations. Firstly, given that adjacent or semantically similar passages generally occupy the same region of the embedding space, this method has the potential to eliminate superfluous evidence. Secondly, it may overlook structurally important segments that are necessary for multi-step reasoning, even if they are not immediately close to the query. Thirdly, while this method treats segments as largely independent units, real-world text corpora possess a structure that includes document order, section hierarchy, shared entities, citations, temporal dependencies, and conceptual links [ 3 ] .
blocks.zh: Retrival-augmented generation(RAG)已经成为将大型语言模型(LLMs)定位于外部公司[1]的实用架构. 在标准管道中,文档被块,块被嵌入,一个查询被嵌入,与查询最相似的顶- k块作为LLM的上下文提供. 深层通道检索[2]和混合的稀疏-深层检索现在被广泛使用,因为这些检索可扩展且对本地事实检索有效。 在本文中,我们认为这一限制因素是两个用于检索的范式的分离. 其中之一是古典的顶- k k 范式, 块根据它们与查询的个别相似性来打分, 并且选择顶级的积分块 。 另一个范式叫做上下文设置检索,目标是找到一组块,共同为生成提供足够的证据. 在这个范式中,一个好的RAG检索器不仅应该能够检索类似于查询的块,而且还应该形成一个连贯的上下文集. 尽管如此,提取顶-k k矢量的方法仍受三个反复限制. 首先,鉴于相邻或相近的段落一般占据嵌入空间的同一区域,这种方法有可能消除多余的证据。 第二,它可能忽略了多步骤推理所必需的结构上重要的部分,即使这些部分并不立即接近查询。 第三,虽然这种方法将片段视为基本独立的单位,但现实世界文本公司(corpora)拥有一个包括文档顺序,段落层次,共享实体,引用,时间依赖,以及概念链接的结构[3].

blocks.en: While the standard top-k retrieval method is practically effective, it is limited when the answer requires a context set rather than a group of similar passages. For dense vector retrieval, chunks are usually ranked based on their individual similarity to the query. The success of this ranking mechanism depends on the local representation of the required evidence in only one or a few semantically similar passages. However, many real-world question-answering (QA) and reasoning tasks require evidence distributed across multiple chunks, documents, or sections. In such cases, the most advantageous setting of context may not be composed of the highest-ranked components alone, but of passages that are jointly relevant, complementary, and structurally interconnected [ 4 ] – [ 6 ] .
blocks.zh: 虽然标准的顶-k检索方法实际上有效,但当答案需要设置上下文而不是一组类似段落时却受到限制. 对于密集的矢量检索,块通常根据其与查询的个别相似性进行排序. 这种排位机制的成功与否,取决于仅在一段或少数几段类似语句中以当地代表方式提出所需证据. 然而,许多现实世界的问答(QA)和推理任务需要分布在多个块,文件或部分的证据. 在这种情况下,最有利的上下文可能不单由排位最高的部分组成,而是由共同相关、互补和结构上相互联系的段落组成[4] - [6]。

blocks.en: Graph-based retrieval methods have emerged as a response to these limitations. Retrieval-augmented generation with graphs (GraphRAG)-style approaches represent information as graphs and exploit relational links to support retrieval and generation across connected evidence [ 6 ] . Related work has explored entity graphs, document graphs, knowledge graphs, and graph-augmented memory structures. For example, GEM-RAG [ 22 ] graphical eigenmemories by tagging data segments with utility questions, connecting them into a graph, and using eigendecomposition to form higher-level memory nodes. CrossAug further highlights that many GraphRAG pipelines miss relations whose supporting evidence spans multiple chunks, and proposes an offline graph-augmentation strategy to recover cross-chunk structure [ 7 ] . These studies indicate that retrieval can benefit from modeling both the semantic similarity between a query and individual chunks and the structural relationships among these chunks.
blocks.zh: 为应对这些局限性,出现了基于图表的检索方法。 以图(GraphRAG)风格的检索式生成法代表作为图的信息,并利用关系链接支持检索和生成跨连接的证据[6]. 相关工作探索了实体图,文档图,知识图,以及图形增强的内存结构. 例如,GEM-RAG [22] 图形化的egenmemories通过标记带有效用问题的数据片段,将它们连接到图中,以及使用egendecomposition来形成更高层次的内存节点. 交叉 Aug进一步强调指出,许多GraphRAG管道错过了其支持证据跨越多个块的关系,并提出了一个离线图增强战略,以恢复跨圆形结构[7]。 这些研究表明,对查询与单个块之间的语义相似性以及这些块之间的结构关系进行建模,可以有利于检索。

blocks.en: However, existing graph-enhanced RAG methods often focus on graph construction, entity-level relations, or community-level summarization. The problem of selecting a compact, diverse, and structurally connected context set remains underexplored. A retrieval system for multi-hop and long-document reasoning should, in principle, be designed to satisfy numerous objectives simultaneously. The goals of this initiative are numerous and include, but are not limited to: • To reduce redundancy, resulting in more efficient and varied retrieval strategies and, hence, greater confidence in the ongoing efforts. • Bridge evidence recovery in process. • Ensure structural coherence of the selected segments is very important.
blocks.zh: 然而,现有的图强化RAG方法往往侧重于图构建,实体层面的关系,或社区一级的汇总. 选择紧凑、多样和结构相连的上下文的问题仍未得到充分探讨。 原则上,应同时设计一个多功能和长文件推理检索系统,以满足众多目标。 这一举措的目标很多,包括但不限于: 减少冗余,使检索战略更加有效和多样,从而增强对当前努力的信心。 • 正在寻找桥梁证据。 • 确保选定部分的结构一致性非常重要。

blocks.en: 1.1 Motivation Behind The Study
blocks.zh: 1.1 背后动机 研究报告

blocks.en: We introduce SpectRAG , a retrieval framework that combines dense candidate seeding with graph-spectral context-set optimization. This framework does not thoroughly replace dense retrieval techniques. Rather, it uses dense vector similarity to generate an initial candidate pool with high recall, then leverages the structure of a weighted chunk graph to refine the final context set. The suggested framework represents chunks using both dense semantic embeddings and spectral coordinates that are derived from the graph Laplacian. These spectral coordinates offer structural insights into the corpus retriever to consider graph connectivity, latent communities, and inter-chunk relationships during the selection process, and enable the retriever to account for graph connectivity, latent communities, and cross-chunk relations during selection.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了SpectRAG, 将密集的候选种子和图谱上下文集优化相结合的检索框架。 这个框架并没有彻底取代密集的检索技术. 相反,它使用密集的矢量相似性来生成一个具有高召回率的初始候选集合,然后利用加权块图的结构来完善最终上下文集. 建议的框架代表块,使用密集的语义嵌入和光谱坐标,这些坐标来自图Laplacian。 这些光谱坐标提供了对本体检索器的结构见解,以便在选择过程中考虑图的连通性、潜在群落和圆丘间关系,并使检索器能够在选择过程中考虑到图的连通性、潜在群落和交叉圆丘间关系。

blocks.en: In the querying stage, SpectRAG converts the user query into embeddings, and then creates a seed set from the embedding space that has high recall. The seed set is then further extended via graph neighborhoods for fetching other related segments that do not necessarily match the query well, but can act as connectors or be evidence itself. The relevance of queries is then propagated to the candidate subgraph that is affected by this, thus making relevance propagate from the matched segments to other related evidence. Finally, SpectRAG applies a token-budgeted context selection stage that assembles the final context under a fixed input budget. This stage prioritizes relevant and structurally connected chunks, preserves a protected core of high-confidence evidence, applies a precision-oriented filtering strategy for lower-ranked candidates, and backfills the remaining budget when necessary to avoid under-utilization of the available context window.
blocks.zh: 在查询阶段,SpectRAG将用户查询转换为嵌入,然后从嵌入空间中创建一个具有高回溯的种子集. 种子集随后通过图区进一步扩展,以获取不一定与查询吻合的其他相关部分,但可以作为连接器或证据本身. 然后将查询的关联性传播到受此影响的候选子图,从而使关联性从对应部分传播到其他相关证据. 最后,SpectRAG采用了一个象征性的编入预算的上下文选择阶段,在固定输入预算下集合最终上下文. 这一阶段优先安排相关和结构相连的块,保留高信任度证据的保护核心,对排名较低的候选人采用精准导向的过滤策略,必要时将剩余预算回填以避免现有上下文窗口利用不足.

blocks.en: 1.2 Limitations of Top-k Dense Retrieval
blocks.zh: 1.2 顶级检索的限制

This setup is computationally efficient and effective as long as the key evidence lies in a single or a few semantically similar chunks [ 1 , 2 ] . blocks.en: Redundancy creates a problem because dense embedding vectors are generally grouped into clusters of adjacent or overlapping chunks of text. In other words, in the case of the selection of the top k k , multiple chunks with identical content will be selected, thereby leaving less space in the context space for different evidence. This becomes a problem in retrieval-augmented generation because of the small size of the context space, leading to fewer pieces of evidence being considered. However, the use of diversity-oriented retrieval can help mitigate the problem [ 4 ] .
blocks.zh: 冗余性造成了一个问题,因为密集的嵌入矢量一般被组合成相邻或重叠块的文本组. 换句话说,在选择顶端k k 的情况下,会选择内容相同的多个块,从而在上下文中为不同的证据留下较少的空间. 由于上下文空间的狭小,这成为检索-增强生成过程中的一个问题,导致考虑的证据件数较少。 然而,采用注重多样性的检索办法可有助于缓解这一问题[4]。

blocks.en: The second limitation is the potential loss of bridge evidence. While answering the question using multi-hop reasoning, the evidence needed for the answer could include some passage chunks bridging entities, events, definitions, references, or claims. Such bridge chunks are not always directly similar to the user query and may therefore receive lower dense similarity scores. Therefore, independent top- k k rankings can retrieve locally relevant passages, but ignore the evidence required to connect them into a total reasoning path. This issue is especially important in benchmarks such as HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and MuSiQue, where supporting evidence is distributed across multiple passages or reasoning steps [ 8 , 9 , 10 ] .
blocks.zh: 第二个限制是可能损失桥梁证据。 在用多跳推理回答问题时,答案所需的证据可包括一些连接实体、事件、定义、参考或索赔的段落块。 这种桥块并不总是与用户查询直接相似,因此可能获得密度较低的类似分数. 因此,独立的顶级-k k 排名可以检索本地相关段落,但忽略了将它们连接到一个总推理路径所需的证据. 这个问题在诸如HotpotQA,2Wiki MultiHopQA,和MuSiQue等基准中特别重要,在这些基准中,辅助证据在多个段落或推理步骤中分布[8,9,10].

blocks.en: The third limitation observed in conventional dense search systems is structure blindness. In this type of system, information is divided into separate divisions for retrieval. However, most databases usually have relationships existing between different parts of information. The relationship could cut across many different dimensions, including document order relationships, hierarchical relationships between different sections of the document, relationships between common entities, citation or referencing that ties one part of information to another, time dependencies that show the timing of the information, as well as conceptual relationships.
blocks.zh: 常规密集搜索系统中观察到的第三个局限性是结构盲. 在这类系统中,信息被分为独立的分部进行检索. 然而,大多数数据库通常在不同的信息部分之间存在关系. 这种关系可能跨越许多不同层面,包括文件命令关系、文件不同部分之间的等级关系、共同实体之间的关系、将一部分信息与另一部分联系在一起的引用或参考、显示信息时间的时间依赖以及概念关系。

blocks.en: These limitations suggest that top- k k dense retrieval should be treated as a strong baseline rather than as the final retrieval objective. This encourages the proposed SpectRAG framework combines hybrid candidate seeding, graph neighborhood expansion, proximity-based re-scoring, and token-budgeted final context selection.
blocks.zh: 这些限制表明,应将顶端-k k 密度检索视为一个强有力的基线,而不是最后的检索目标。 这鼓励拟议的SpectRAG框架结合混合候选种子,图示邻里扩展,近距离重评,以及象征性预算的最后背景选择.

blocks.en: 1.3 Contributions
blocks.zh: 1.3 缴款

blocks.en: To summarize, the essential contributions of this research are outlined as follows: • SpectRAG, a spectral graph-augmented retrieval framework integrates dense vector search, weighted chunk graph construction, Laplacian spectral coordinates, graph-based candidate expansion, relevance diffusion, and cluster-aware final selection. • A graph-based retrieval pipeline that uses dense retrieval as an initial entry point and then exploits graph structure to recover bridge evidence and reduce redundant context. • A reproducible evaluation protocol for assessing SpectRAG on multi-hop and long-document question-answering benchmarks, including MultiHopRAG, HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, MuSiQue, and long-document QA datasets. • We design an ablation study to isolate the contribution of graph expansion, spectral coordinates, diffusion, graph edge signals, and diversity-aware context selection.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,这一研究的主要贡献概述如下:光谱RAG,一个光谱图增强检索框架,综合了密集矢量搜索、加权块图构造、拉普拉西亚光谱坐标、基于图表的候选扩展、相关性传播和群集意识最终选择。 一个基于图表的检索管道,使用密集检索作为初始切入点,然后利用图表结构来回收桥面证据,减少冗余上下文. • 支助 为评估SpectRAG关于多跳和长文件问答基准的可复制评价协议,包括MultiHopRAG,HotpotQA,2WikiMultiHopQA,MuSiQue,以及长文件QA数据集. ^ 我们设计了一项消融研究,以隔离图的扩展,光谱坐标,扩散,图边信号,以及多样性的上下文选择的贡献.

blocks.en: SpectRAG is a retrieval framework that augments dense vector search with a weighted chunk graph and the spectral structure of its graph Laplacian. Rather than treating dense retrieval and graph-based retrieval as competing alternatives, SpectRAG adopts dense vector search as a high-recall entry point and subsequently exploits graph structure to expand, diffuse, diversify, and select the final context set. Each chunk is defined using both its dense semantic embedding and graph-spectral coordinates derived from a weighted chunk graph. The graph can integrate numerous edge signals, including semantic similarity, document adjacency, section hierarchy, shared entities, citation relations, and similarity between LLM-generated utility queries.
blocks.zh: SpectRAG是一个检索框架,用加权块图及其图拉普拉西安的光谱结构来增强密集矢量搜索. SpectRAG不把密集检索和基于图表的检索作为相互竞争的替代品,而是采用密集矢量检索作为高召入点,然后利用图表结构来扩展、分散、多样化和选择最后的上下文集。 每个块都使用其密集的语义嵌入和从加权块图中得出的图谱坐标来定义。 该图可以整合众多的边缘信号,包括语义相似性,文档辅助性,段落层次,共享实体,引用关系,以及LLM生成的效用查询之间的相似性.

blocks.en: 2.1 Retrieval-Augmented Generation
blocks.zh: 2.1 回收-强化一代

blocks.en: RAG is a method which integrates user query with related passages from an external knowledge source [ 3 , 8 ] . The system being studied includes two core elements: the retrieval component and the generation component . The retrieval component identifies relevant passages for the query made by the user, whereas the generation component uses those passages as context to generate a response.
blocks.zh: RAG是一种将用户查询与外部知识源的相关段落[3,8]整合的方法. 正在研究的系统包括两个核心要素:检索组件和生成组件。 检索部分确定用户查询的相关段落,而生成部分则使用这些段落作为上下文生成答复。

blocks.en: Previous RAG models have demonstrated that the combination of parametric language models with non-parametric external memories works well for knowledge-heavy tasks where the required information cannot be completely represented by the model parameters or where information changes over time. In real-world scenarios, the retrieval process is typically carried out using methods such as sparse retrieval, BM25 retrieval [ 11 ] , dense passage retrieval, or a combination of sparse and dense retrieval.Sparse retrievers perform retrieval based on keyword matching, whereas dense retrievers map the query and documents into a vector space and retrieve semantically similar passages.
blocks.zh: 之前的RAG模型已经证明,将参数化语言模型与非参数化的外部记忆结合起来,对于知识重的任务来说效果很好,因为模型参数不能完全代表所需的信息,或者信息随时间而变化. 在现实世界的情景中,检索过程一般采用稀疏检索,BM25检索[11],稠密通道检索,或稀疏密集检索组合等方法进行. Sparse检索器根据关键词匹配进行检索,而密集的检索器则将查询和文件映射到矢量空间并检索类似段落。

blocks.en: Although it is effective, traditional RAG generally counts on independently ranked passages. While this design is adequate for local factual lookups, it may prove inadequate when the answer requires evidence distributed across multiple passages, documents, or structural relations. Recent research has sought to enhance not only the relevance of retrieved passages but also the overall coherence and diversity of the final context, encouraging the audience to feel optimistic about future developments.
blocks.zh: 传统RAG虽然有效,但一般依靠独立排名的段落. 虽然这一设计适合当地的事实观察,但如果答案需要分散在多个段落、文件或结构关系中的证据,则可能证明不充分。 最近的研究不仅力求提高检索段落的相关性,而且力求提高最终背景的整体一致性和多样性,鼓励观众对未来发展感到乐观。

blocks.en: 2.2 Diversity-Aware and Context-Set Retrieval
blocks.zh: 2.2 了解多样性和检索背景

blocks.en: The conventional systems of retrieval concentrate on the relevance of the individual passages but not on the assessment of the relevance of the entire set of retrieved passages. The generator takes the set of passages and the relevance of such a set depends not only on the relevance of the individual passage to the given query but also on the complementarity, non-redundancy, and sufficiency of the passages, making it evident that non-redundancy plays an important role in information retrieval.
blocks.zh: 传统的检索系统侧重于单个段落的相关性,而不是评估整个一组检索段落的相关性。 生成器取一系列的通道,而这种通道的相关性不仅取决于单个通道与给定的查询的相关性,还取决于通道的互补性,不重复性和充分性,使得不重复显然在信息检索中起着重要的作用.

blocks.en: In the context of RAG, context-set retrieval is the process of selecting a subset of passages that optimizes set utility. The selected context set needs to preserve query relevance, cover evidence from all sides, avoid repetition, and provide enough data for generation. In multihop reasoning tasks and long-document reasoning, the selected context must also be coherent across related passages, since the answer to the question may depend on connecting evidence from different parts of the corpus [ 13 ] . Relationship-aware table discovery methods, such as SANTOS, similarly show that semantic relationships among structured data elements can improve search beyond column- or item-level matching alone [ 14 ] .
blocks.zh: 在RAG中,上下文集检索是选择一个子集,优化设置效用的过程. 所选的上下文集需要保留查询相关性,覆盖来自各方的证据,避免重复,并为生成提供足够的数据. 在多跳推理任务和长文件推理中,选定的上下文还必须在相关段落之间保持一致,因为对问题的答案可能取决于将本体不同部分的证据联系起来[13]. SANTOS等关系认识表的发现方法同样表明结构化数据元素之间的语义关系可以改善搜索,超越列或项级单比[14].

blocks.en: A conceptual comparison between independent dense retrieval and the proposed SpectRAG strategy is shown in Fig. 1 . In standard dense retrieval, passages are ranked independently based on their similarity to the query, which can lead to redundant passages, missing bridge evidence, and disconnected support. In contrast, SpectRAG constructs the final context by combining relevance, graph connectivity, spectral diffusion and diversity-aware selection under a token-budget constraint.
blocks.zh: 图1显示了独立密集检索与拟议的SpectRAG战略之间的概念比较。 在标准的密集检索中,通过内容根据其与查询的相似性而独立排序,这可能导致多余的通道,缺失的桥面证据,以及断开支持. 相比之下,SpectRAG通过结合关联性,图示连通性,光谱传播和在象征性的预算制约下选择多样性来构建最终上下文.

blocks.en: This perspective is further developed in SpectRAG through token-budgeted context assembly. In contrast to conventional top-ranked retrieval, where the final passages are selected only according to independent similarity scores, SpectRAG constructs the final context under a fixed token budget. Candidate chunks are evaluated not only by relevance, but also by graph proximity, document coverage, redundancy, and their contribution to a compact evidence set. This design allows the system to preserve high-confidence evidence while using the remaining budget for complementary and structurally useful chunks [ 15 ] .
blocks.zh: 在SpectRAG中,通过象征性的编入预算的上下文组装,进一步发展了这一视角。 相对于常规的顶级检索,最终段落只根据独立的相似性分数来选择,SpectRAG在固定符号预算下构建最终上下文. 不仅通过相关性,而且通过图近、文件覆盖面、冗余及其对一套紧凑证据的贡献,来评价候选块。 这种设计使该系统能够保留高度自信的证据,同时将剩余的预算用于补充和结构有用的块[15]。

blocks.en: 2.3 Graph-Enhanced Retrieval and GraphRAG
blocks.zh: 2.3 增强的检索和制图

blocks.en: GraphRAG methods explicitly represent corpus structure. Edge et al. [ 12 ] propose a graph-based approach to query-focused summarization in which an LLM extracts an entity knowledge graph, groups related entities into communities, generates community summaries, and uses these summaries to answer global questions over a corpus. This method addresses questions such as identifying themes or relationships across many documents, where naive local retrieval can fail.
blocks.zh: GraphRAG方法明确代表实体结构。 Edge 等 (英语). [12] 提出了以图表为基础的注重查询的汇总方法,其中LLM提取一个实体知识图,将相关实体分组为社区,生成社区摘要,并利用这些摘要解答全球问题。 这种方法涉及诸如在许多文档中识别主题或关系等问题,在这些文档中,天真本地检索可能失败.

blocks.en: Graph-enhanced retrieval is especially relevant when answer evidence is distributed across multiple pieces of text. Zhang et al. [ 7 ] argue that existing GraphRAG systems often extract relations within individual chunks, leaving cross-chunk relations systematically absent. Their CrossAug method enriches graph indices with missing cross-chunk relational structure using a topology-aware graph neural network and targeted LLM completion.
blocks.zh: 在将回答证据分布在多个文本之间时,图强化检索特别相关。 张等. [7] 认为现有的GraphRAG系统常常在单个块内提取关系,使得横冲直撞的关系系统性地缺失. 他们的十字 Aug方法利用地貌-认知图神经网络和定向LLM完成,用缺失的跨圆形关系结构来丰富图指数.

blocks.en: The offline indexing stage is summarized in Table 1 . This stage is executed once for each document collection and includes token-based chunking, dense embedding computation, edge-signal extraction, weighted graph construction, spectral decomposition, Neo4j graph persistence, and disk-level storage of chunks, embeddings, spectral coordinates, utility questions, and FAISS indexes. This design separates expensive corpus-level preprocessing from query-time retrieval, allowing the online pipeline to reuse precomputed graph and spectral artifacts.

blocks.en: Furthermore, the online query-time procedure is outlined in Table 1 . For each query, SpectRAG first performs hybrid seed retrieval by fusing dense FAISS scores, BM25 lexical retrieval, and utility-question matching. The seed set is then expanded through two-hop graph traversal, re-scored using a combination of relevance and graph proximity, and assembled into a final context using token-budgeted selection. The final context is grouped by source document and passed to the generator together with ranked source metadata.

blocks.en: 3.3 Documents Chunking

blocks.en: The chunking process involves adaptive structure-aware chunking, which is done by picking one of two segmentations for each document. Documents with explicit structure information, such as Markdown markup or section numbering, employ the structural segmentation, splitting text along the hierarchical structure, propagating the entire path through the sections hierarchy (e.g., 2. Methods → 2.1 Datasets) as chunk metadata; the section-affinity edge generation will use this hierarchy. For unstructured text, the semantic mode is applied: sentences are embedded using the same model as for document embedding (nomic-embed-text), and breakpoints are inserted at places where the embedding distance between two sentences exceeds the 90th percentile of the entire document distance distribution, resulting in topically coherent segments independently of the document surface format. In both segmentation modes, the chunk size is measured in tokens using the cl100k_base tokenizer, with a maximum number of tokens set to 1,200 tokens with 100-token overlap as a suffix of the previous chunk that respects sentence boundaries. Chunks with less than 32 tokens are concatenated with the previous chunk, and tables are parsed separately, serializing them to Markdown so that rows are not split.

blocks.en: The selection procedure consists of three practical components. First, SpectRAG preserves a protected core of high-confidence chunks so that strongly relevant evidence is not removed by later diversity or budget constraints. Second, it applies a precision-oriented tail selection strategy for lower-ranked candidates, using graph proximity, cluster coverage, document coverage, and redundancy penalties to decide which additional chunks should enter the context. Third, if the budget is not fully used, a backfill step adds remaining high-quality candidates so that the generator is not deprived of useful evidence.
blocks.zh: 甄选程序由三个实际部分组成。 首先,我们... SpectRAG保留了一个受保护的高度自信块核心,这样,强烈相关的证据不会因为后来的多样性或预算限制而被移除. 第二,它对排名较低的候选人采用精准的尾部选择战略,利用图近、集群覆盖、文件覆盖和冗余处罚来决定哪些额外的块应进入上下文。 第三,如果预算没有得到充分使用,则回填步骤会增加其余的高质量候选人,这样发电机就不会失去有用的证据。

blocks.en: This token-budgeted design differs from fixed- k k context selection. Instead of forcing every query to receive the same number of chunks, SpectRAG adapts the number of selected chunks to their token lengths and the available context window. In the current implementation, this typically produces a final context of approximately 10–15 chunks under a context budget of about 12k tokens. The resulting context set is intended to be relevant, non-redundant, structurally connected, and sufficiently broad for grounded generation.
blocks.zh: 此符号预算设计不同于固定的- k k 上下文选择 。 SpectRAG没有强制每个查询接收相同的块数,而是将所选块数调整到它们的符号长度和可用的上下文窗口. 在目前的执行中,这通常会产生大约10至15块的最后背景,其背景预算大约为12千令牌。 由此产生的一套背景是相关的、不重复的、结构上连通的,而且对于有根基的一代来说足够广泛。

blocks.en: To estimate SpectRAG’s effectiveness across a range of domains and content types, we used four datasets from the UltraDomain [ 16 ] and employed specific evaluation metrics such as precision, recall and f1 to quantify performance. blocks.en: The UltraDomain benchmark is derived from 428 college textbooks covering 18 domains, including agriculture, the social sciences, and the humanities [ 16 ] . blocks.en: 4.3 Implementation Parameters and Details

blocks.en: For the analysis of the impact of retrieval granularity, we consider SpectRAG under two token-level chunking schemes. In the first token-based configuration, the chunk size is set to 256 tokens with an overlap of 64 tokens. This setting produces smaller retrieval units and allows the token-budgeted selector to compose evidence at a finer granularity. The second scheme utilizes a chunk size of 1200 tokens with an overlap of 100 tokens. This scheme produces larger retrieval chunks and enables the rich local context of documents to be retained in the retrieved candidates.

blocks.en: 4.4 Baselines
blocks.zh: 4.4 基线

blocks.en: We compare SpectRAG against the following state-of-the-art approaches: • NaiveRAG [ 19 ] : This model follows the conventional indexing, retrieval, and generation process. Chunks are extracted from documents, embedded, and stored in a vector database; during inference, the query is embedded, and the top- k k most similar chunks are retrieved and concatenated into a prompt for an LLM to generate the answer. • HybridRAG [ 20 ] : This approach integrates BM25 sparse lexical retrieval and dense semantic retrieval, merging their ranked lists using RRF. In addition, uncertainty quantification (UQ) is incorporated to estimate the confidence of the retrieved evidence and the generated response, allowing low-reliability outputs to be flagged. • LightRAG [ 18 ] : This model uses an LLM to extract entities and relations from documents and stores them as a knowledge graph, as implemented in LightRAG. Retrieval is performed at two levels, namely entity-level and thematic-level, enabling the system to capture multi-hop and cross-document dependencies that flat chunk-based indexes cannot represent. • HyDeRAG [ 21 ] : Retrieval based on Hypothetical Document Embeddings (HyDE), which closes the semantic gap between a short query and a document by using an LLM to generate a hypothetical answer to the query. The generated synthetic document is then embedded and used in place of the raw query embedding for the similarity search, increasing the likelihood of retrieving the relevant chunks.
blocks.zh: 我们比较SpectRAG与下列最新方法: • NaiveRAG[19]: 这种模式遵循传统的索引编制、检索和生成过程。 从文档中提取块,嵌入,并存储在一个矢量数据库中;在推论中,查询被嵌入,最相似的上- k k 块被检索并缩合成一个LLM生成答案的提示. • 混合[20]: 这种方法整合了BM25稀疏的词典检索和密集的语义检索,用RRF合并了它们的排名列表. 此外,还纳入了不确定性量化(UQ),以估计所获取证据和生成的响应的可信度,从而能够标出低可靠性产出。 • LightRAG [18]: 这个模型使用LLM从文档中提取实体和关系,并作为知识图存储,在LightRAG中实施. 检索工作在两个层面进行,即实体层面和专题层面,使系统能够捕捉平方块索引不能代表的多跳和跨文档依赖性。 • 海德拉格[21]: 基于伪文档嵌入式(HyDE)的检索,它通过使用LLM生成对查询的假设答案来弥补一个简短的查询与文档之间的语义差距. 生成的合成文档随后被嵌入并用于取代类似性搜索的原始查询嵌入,增加了检索相关块的可能性.

In addition, uncertainty quantification (UQ) is incorporated to estimate the confidence of the retrieved evidence and the generated response, allowing low-reliability outputs to be flagged.
blocks.zh: [20]: 这种方法整合了BM25稀疏的词典检索和密集的语义检索,用RRF合并了它们的排名列表. 此外,还纳入了不确定性量化(UQ),以估计所获取证据和生成的响应的可信度,从而能够标出低可靠性产出。

blocks.en: LightRAG [ 18 ] : This model uses an LLM to extract entities and relations from documents and stores them as a knowledge graph, as implemented in LightRAG. Retrieval is performed at two levels, namely entity-level and thematic-level, enabling the system to capture multi-hop and cross-document dependencies that flat chunk-based indexes cannot represent.
blocks.zh: LightRAG [18]: (英语). 这个模型使用LLM从文档中提取实体和关系,并作为知识图存储,在LightRAG中实施. 检索工作在两个层面进行,即实体层面和专题层面,使系统能够捕捉平方块索引不能代表的多跳和跨文档依赖性。

blocks.en: HyDeRAG [ 21 ] : Retrieval based on Hypothetical Document Embeddings (HyDE), which closes the semantic gap between a short query and a document by using an LLM to generate a hypothetical answer to the query. The generated synthetic document is then embedded and used in place of the raw query embedding for the similarity search, increasing the likelihood of retrieving the relevant chunks.
blocks.zh: [21]: 基于伪文档嵌入式(HyDE)的检索,它通过使用LLM生成对查询的假设答案来弥补一个简短的查询与文档之间的语义差距. 生成的合成文档随后被嵌入并用于取代类似性搜索的原始查询嵌入,增加了检索相关块的可能性.

blocks.en: 4.6 Preliminary Generation-Level Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.6 初步代际评价

blocks.en:
For the preliminary generation-level evaluation, we compared SpectRAG and NaiveRAG on a subset of the UltraDomain dataset using a pairwise approach. For each domain, we indexed all documents and selected 20 sample questions. An LLM-as-judge protocol was used, with the judge model kept distinct from the generation model to eliminate self-preference bias. The judge received both candidates’ answers and issued the final verdict, operating at 0 temperature to maximize determinism. The evaluation follows a LightRAG-style sensemaking protocol, in which answers are judged pairwise across multiple qualitative dimensions. To mitigate position bias, the answer order was swapped during judging.
The pairwise win rates for SpectRAG and NaiveRAG are reported in Table 9 and Table 10 , where each row sums to 100%. Values above 50% indicate an advantage for SpectRAG over NaiveRAG. SpectRAG outperformed NaiveRAG across all dimensions, with the largest margin observed for diversity, at 55.0%. This suggests that graph-spectral contextual selection can improve the structural coherence of retrieval and, in turn, the quality of generated answers.

对于初步的生成级评价,我们用双向方法比较了SpectRAG和NaiveRAG在超域数据集的一个子集上. 对于每个域,我们对所有文档进行索引,并选择了20个抽样问题. 使用了LLM-as-judge协议,法官模式与生成模式保持区别,以消除自我偏好偏差。 法官收到了两位候选人的回答,并发布了最后判决,在0度温度下运作,以最大限度地确定性。 评估遵循一种LightRAG式的感知协议,其中在多个质量层面对答案进行对等判断. 为了减轻位置偏差,在判断时交换了答案顺序.

blocks.en: Because SpectRAG defines its graph over document chunks rather than LLM-extracted entities, it represents every evaluated corpus with substantially fewer nodes and a smaller on-disk index, while matching or exceeding LightRAG on retrieval quality. The node reduction holds across all five corpora, ranging from 2.8 × 2.8\times to 6.6 × 6.6\times fewer nodes, and the complete persisted index on MultiHopRAG is 6 × 6\times smaller (46 MB versus 274 MB), since SpectRAG maintains only a single chunk-level vector index and a spectral basis and eliminates LightRAG’s separate entity (100 MB) and relationship (106 MB) vector databases. This lighter representation does not sacrifice quality: on MultiHopRAG’s gold-evidence annotations, SpectRAG attains a Recall@5 of 65.2 against LightRAG’s 49.5, with comparable answer accuracy. SpectRAG therefore realizes a favorable cost and quality trade-off, offering a compact, denser chunk graph that competes with a state-of-the-art entity-graph baseline at a fraction of its index footprint. blocks.en: SpectRAG matches the graph-RAG baseline and clearly outperforms the vector-RAG baseline on objective answer accuracy. On MultiHopRAG’s 2,556 gold-answer questions, SpectRAG attains an EM of 72.0 and F1 of 72.4, exceeding NaiveRAG (EM 65.2 / F1 65.6) by roughly seven points, and is on par with LightRAG (EM 70.5 / F1 70.9), marginally ahead. Notably, SpectRAG’s large retrieval advantage over LightRAG (Recall@5 64.7 versus 49.2) translates into only a small answer-accuracy gain. This reflects the retrieval and generation gap: multi-hop answers are short (often yes/no or a single entity) and reachable from partial evidence, and all systems share the same generator model, temperature 0, identical prompt), so beyond a sufficiency threshold, additional retrieved evidence yields diminishing returns on final accuracy. SpectRAG’s contribution is therefore a stronger, substantially cheaper retriever (RQ1), delivering answer accuracy that matches the state-of-the-art graph-RAG system while decisively surpassing standard vector retrieval. Detailed answer-accuracy results are reported in Section 5.3 (generation-level results).

blocks.en: SpectRAG’s spectral and PPR diffusion not only surfaces more gold evidence; it ranks that evidence higher in the retrieved context, outperforming both baselines at every retrieval depth and on mean reciprocal rank. Against LightRAG, SpectRAG improves mean reciprocal rank (MRR) from 61.5 to 70.4 and recall at every cutoff (Recall@2 39.1 versus 31.2, Recall@5 64.7 versus 49.2, Recall@10 84.0 versus 61.8). Against NaiveRAG, it likewise leads on MRR (68.5 versus 65.5) and on Recall@2, @5, and @10. A higher MRR means the first gold document appears earlier in the context, which directly benefits the generator, as it attends most strongly to top-ranked passages. SpectRAG therefore delivers not just broader but better-ordered retrieval, the property that most affects downstream answering. Detailed retrieval-ranking results are reported in Section 5.2 (Retrieval-Level Results).
blocks.zh: SpectRAG的光谱和PR扩散不仅能显示更多的黄金证据;它在检索的上下文中排名更高,在每一检索深度和平均对等等级上都比基线高。 对LightRAG而言,SpectRAG的对应级别从61.5级提高到70.4级,并在每次截断时都召回(召回@2 39.1对31.2,召回@5 64.7对49.2,召回@10 84.0对61.8)。 反NaiveRAG,它同样在MRR(68.5对65.5)和召回@2,@5和@10方面领先. 较高的MRR意味着第一个金色文件在上下文中出现较早,这直接有利于生成者,因为它在排位最高的段落中参与得最多. 因此,SpectRAG不仅提供范围更广,而且提供更有序的检索,即影响下游应答的产权。 第5.2节(检索级结果)报告了详细的检索级结果。

blocks.en: 5.1 Main Results
blocks.zh: 5.1 主要成果

blocks.en: SpectRAG delivers two complementary advantages: an efficiency-at-parity result on MultiHopRAG and a quality result on UltraDomain. On MultiHopRAG, SpectRAG matches LightRAG’s objective answer accuracy and decisively outperforms NaiveRAG ( subsection 5.3 ), while retrieving gold evidence more effectively and ranking it higher within the context ( subsection 5.2 ) all at substantially lower index cost, evidenced by a markedly smaller graph and on-disk footprint. On UltraDomain, SpectRAG wins the pairwise LLM-judge evaluation against NaiveRAG, HyDE, and Hybrid, remains competitive with LightRAG, and shows a clear advantage in answer diversity (Table 4 ); a representative example is examined in Table 5 . Concurrently, these results address RQ1–RQ3: SpectRAG achieves competitive-to-superior retrieval at markedly lower index cost (RQ1), improves holistic answer quality relative to graph-RAG baselines (RQ2), and matches or exceeds their objective accuracy without sacrificing efficiency (RQ3).
blocks.zh: SpectRAG有两个互补优势:在多HopRAG上实现效率均等,在UltraDomain上实现质量. 在MultiHopRAG上,SpectRAG与LightRAG的客观答案准确性相匹配,并决定性地超越了NaiveRAG(第5.3分节),同时在上下文(第5.2分节)中更有效地检索黄金证据并将其排在较高位置,其指数成本都低得多,以明显较小的图表和磁盘足迹为证明。 在超域上,SpectRAG赢得了对NaiveRAG、HyDE和Hybrid的双向LLM判断评价,与LightRAG保持竞争力,并显示出答案多样性的明显优势(表4);表5审查了一个有代表性的例子。 同时,这些结果还涉及RQ1-RQ3: SpectRAG以显著较低的指数成本(RQ1)实现竞争性对超级检索,相对于图-RAG基线(RQ2)提高整体答题质量,在不牺牲效率的情况下匹配或超过其客观准确性(RQ3).

blocks.en: 5.2 Retrieval-Level Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 检索级结果

blocks.en: SpectRAG demonstrates a substantial improvement over LightRAG in retrieval quality, as evidenced by the ranking of gold evidence and recall across all evaluated cutoffs. Table 6 reports MRR and Recall@ k k on MultiHopRAG. SpectRAG attains an MRR of 70.4, compared to 61.5 for LightRAG, and outperforms LightRAG across all recall cutoffs (Recall@2, @5, and @10: 39.1/64.7/84.0 versus 31.2/49.2/61.8). This advantage is not confined to aggregate performance but extends across all reasoning-intensive question types: Recall@5 favors SpectRAG on comparison (72.0 versus 54.8), inference (53.7 versus 38.8), and temporal (69.5 versus 55.5) questions. This consistency indicates that the observed retrieval gain reflects a general property of the retrieval mechanism rather than an artifact of any particular question type. Taken together with the ranking results, these findings address RQ4 and the retrieval component of RQ1, demonstrating that SpectRAG retrieves gold evidence more frequently and ranks it higher in context than LightRAG, consistently across question types.
blocks.zh: SpectRAG在检索质量方面比LightRAG大有改进,黄金证据的排名和在所有评估断层中的召回都证明了这一点。 表6报告了MRR和MultiHopRAG上的召回@kk。 SpectRAG的MRR为70.4,而LightRAG的MR为61.5,在所有召回截断点上都超过了LightRAG(Recall@2,@5和@10:39.1/64.7/84.0,对31.2/49.2/61.8)。 这一优势不仅限于总体性能,而是扩展到所有推理密集型问题类型:Recall@5赞成SpectRAG比较(72.0对54.8),推论(53.7对38.8)和时间问题(69.5对55.5)。 这种一致性表明,观察到的检索收益反映了检索机制的一般属性,而不是任何特定问题类型的文物。 结合排名结果,这些结果涉及RQ4和RQ1的检索部分,表明SpectRAG检索黄金证据的次数较多,在背景上比LightRAG更高,在问题类型上始终如此。

blocks.en: NaiveRAG is excluded from the primary comparison, as its retrieval scores are not directly comparable under our evidence-attribution protocol. 1 1 1 NaiveRAG’s chunk-level retrieval does not map cleanly onto the graph-node attribution scheme used to compute gold-evidence recall for LightRAG and SpectRAG; the resulting NaiveRAG figures constitute a lower bound and are therefore omitted from the primary analysis to avoid an inequitable comparison. NaiveRAG’s generation-level results are reported in Section 5.3 , where objective accuracy is directly comparable across all baselines.
blocks.zh: NaiveRAG被排除在主比较之外,因为根据我们的证据分配协议,它的检索分数不具有直接可比性。 1 1 1 NaiveRAG的块级检索没有清晰地映射到用于计算LightRAG和SpectRAG的黄金证据召回的图点归属方案;由此得出的NaiveRAG数字构成较低的约束,因此在主分析中被省略,以避免不公平的比较。 NaiveRAG的生成结果在第5.3节中报告,在该节中,在所有基线中,客观准确度是可直接比较的。

blocks.en: Table 6: Retrieval ranking quality on MultiHopRAG.
blocks.zh: 表6:在MultiHopRAG上检索排名质量.

blocks.en: 5.3 Generation-Level Results
blocks.zh: 5.3 代级成果

blocks.en: This study aims to investigate end-to-end answer accuracy by employing a common generator across all five systems. This standardized approach ensures that any observed variations in performance are indicative of the retrieval quality, rather than discrepancies in the generative process itself. The overall accuracy reported on MultiHopRAG’s 2,556 gold-answer questions demonstrates the evaluation’s relevance and credibility. Objective accuracy is directly comparable across all baselines here, including NaiveRAG, whose retrieval scores were excluded from the retrieval-level analysis. Table 7 reports overall accuracy on the MultiHopRAG dataset.
blocks.zh: 这项研究旨在通过在所有五个系统中使用通用发电机来调查端到端答的准确性。 这种标准化方法确保所观察到的性能变化表明检索质量,而不是基因过程本身的差异。 MultiHopRAG的2 556个金子回答问题报告的总体准确性表明评价的相关性和可信度。 客观准确性可直接比较于这里的所有基线,包括NaiveRAG,其检索分数被排除在检索级分析之外. 表7报告了MultiHopRAG数据集的总体准确性。

blocks.en: Table 7: Overall answer accuracy on MultiHopRAG dataset.
blocks.zh: 表7:MultiHopRAG数据集的总体答案准确性.

blocks.en: SpectRAG attains the highest overall accuracy of all five systems on every metric (EM 71.2, F1 71.6, and contains 71.6). The margin over the next-best systems, LightRAG and Hybrid (both near 70.6), is narrow, while the gap over NaiveRAG (67.8) and HyDE (65.2) is substantial. Unlike the retrieval-level comparison, where SpectRAG’s advantage was large, this is a clean but marginal win across the board. This is precisely the retrieval–generation gap in action: because all systems share the same generator and multi-hop answers are typically short (a yes/no verdict or a single entity) and often recoverable from partial evidence, retrieval improvements compress once a sufficiency threshold is reached, and additional or better-ordered evidence yields diminishing returns on final accuracy.
blocks.zh: SpectRAG在每个度量衡上达到所有五个系统的最高总体精度(EM 71.2,F1 71.6,包含71.6). 在LightRAG和Hybrid(两者都接近70.6)这些次最佳系统的比值较小,而NaiveRAG(67.8)和HyDE(65.2)的差距很大。 与SpectRAG优势较大的检索级比较不同,这是一个干净但微不足道的全局胜利. 这恰恰是检索-生成在行动中的差距:因为所有系统都共用同一个生成器,而多跳的答案通常很短(是/否或单一实体),而且往往可以从部分证据中收回,一旦达到足够阈值,检索改进就会压缩,额外或更有序的证据在最终准确性上产生收益下降。

blocks.en: To make this compression concrete, Table 8 breaks accuracy down by question type. The per-type view shows that the small aggregate margin masks a mix of clear wins and near-ties.
blocks.zh: 为了制作这种压缩混凝土,表8按问题类型细分精度. 每类观点显示,小的聚合比值掩盖了明显的胜负和近乎的混合.

blocks.en: Table 8: Per-type answer accuracy on MultiHopRAG.
blocks.zh: 表8:MultiHopRAG上的单型答案精度。

blocks.en: The per-type breakdown clarifies where SpectRAG’s aggregate win originates. SpectRAG dominates on inference questions (95.1, roughly three points above LightRAG and Hybrid and eight above the vector baselines), the type most dependent on assembling evidence across multiple hops, which is exactly where a stronger, better-ordered retriever should help. On comparison and temporal questions the systems cluster tightly, with LightRAG marginally ahead (66.4 and 44.9), confirming that once sufficient evidence is retrieved, the shared generator equalizes performance and small retrieval differences no longer separate the systems. The null category behaves differently: it rewards correct abstention rather than evidence assembly, and here the vector baselines (89.7) and Hybrid (87.4) lead, while SpectRAG (83.1) still comfortably exceeds LightRAG (72.8). SpectRAG’s lower null score reflects its tendency to surface candidate evidence even for unanswerable queries, a direct consequence of its broader retrieval, and represents the one regime where more aggressive retrieval is mildly counterproductive.
blocks.zh: SpectRAG的总赢来自何处? SpectRAG在推论问题上占据主导地位(95.1,大约高于LightRAG和Hybrid,高于矢量基线的8个点),这一类型最依赖于跨多个跳跃集合证据,这正是一个更强大,更有序的检索器应该帮助的地方. 在比较和时间问题上,各系统紧紧组合在一起,LightRAG稍稍领先(66.4和44.9),证实一旦收集到足够的证据,共享生成器将性能和微小的检索差异等同起来,不再将系统分开。 无效类别的行为不同:它奖励的是正确的弃权而不是证据组装,这里的矢量基线(89.7)和混合(87.4)铅,而SpectRAG(83.1)仍然舒适地超过了LightRAG(72.8)。 SpectRAG的低无效分数反映了它往往露出候选证据,即使是无法回答的询问,这是其更广泛的检索的直接结果,并且代表了一个较激进的检索稍适得其反的制度。

blocks.en: Considered collectively, the generation-level results confirm the paper’s central claim: SpectRAG’s value is a stronger and substantially cheaper retriever (RQ1), which converts into the best overall answer accuracy among all five systems and a decisive lead on the most retrieval-intensive question type, while the shared generator and short answer format cap how large that lead can become on the remaining types.
blocks.zh: 产生结果证实了文件的核心主张: SpectRAG的值是更强、更便宜的检索器(RQ1),它可以在所有五个系统中转换为最佳的总体答题精确度,并在最检索密集的问题类型上具有决定性的领先性,而共享的生成器和短答格式则封顶了剩余类型铅的大小。

blocks.en: 5.4 Diversity, Redundancy, and Connectivity Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.4 多样性、冗余性和连通性分析

blocks.en: To assess whether SpectRAG’s denser, spectrally-organized chunk graph produces qualitatively richer answers, we evaluate SpectRAG (SpectRAG) against four baselines (NaiveRAG, HyDE, Hybrid, and LightRAG) using the UltraDomain-style pairwise win-rate protocol, in which a gpt-4o judge selects the preferred answer across four dimensions: comprehensiveness, diversity, empowerment, and overall quality. Each pair of columns reports the win rate (%) of the named baseline versus SpectRAG on a given domain; the two columns in each pair sum to 100, and an SpectRAG value above 50 indicates SpectRAG is preferred. Table 9 reports the results under the first edge-signal configuration: semantic 0.300, section 0.250, entity 0.200, adjacency 0.084, utility question 0.083, and citation 0.083.
blocks.zh: 为了评估SpectRAG更密集、光谱排列的块图是否产生质量更丰富的答案,我们用超域型双向双向协议(gpt-4o法官在其中从四个方面选择首选答案:全面性、多样性、增强能力和整体质量),根据四个基线(NaiveRAG、HyDE、Hybrid和LightRAG)对SpectRAG(SpectRAG)进行评估。 每对列报告指定域上命名基线的胜率(%)相对于SpectRAG;每对总数为100的两列,超过50的SpectRAG值表示偏好SpectRAG. 表9汇报了第一个边缘信号配置下的结果:语义0.300,第0.250节,实体0.20,辅音0.084,功用问题0.083,引文0.083。

blocks.en: Table 9: Win rates (%) of baselines versus SpectRAG across four domains and four dimensions (signal configuration 1: semantic 0.300, section 0.250, entity 0.200, adjacency 0.084, utility question 0.083, citation 0.083)
blocks.zh: 表9:基线相对于SpectRAG在四个领域和四个维度的胜率(%)(符号配置1:语义0.300,0.250节,实体0.20,附则0.084,功用问题0.083,引文0.083)

blocks.en: Two patterns are consistent under this configuration. First, diversity is SpectRAG’s strongest dimension against every baseline : it wins on average 64.1 against NaiveRAG, 71.5 against HyDE, 60.6 against Hybrid, and 55.0 against LightRAG. This is the signature of a retriever that spreads its evidence across structurally distinct regions of the graph rather than concentrating it in a small, redundant neighborhood. Second, the margin scales with how redundancy-prone the baseline is : SpectRAG wins all four dimensions decisively against HyDE and NaiveRAG, leads throughout against Hybrid, and against LightRAG is close to even on comprehensiveness, empowerment, and overall (49.7, 48.4, 48.7) while still winning diversity (55.0). Even when the two graph-based systems are matched on aggregate quality, SpectRAG’s denser chunk graph continues to deliver more varied, less redundant evidence, consistent with its higher edges-per-node ratio (RQ1).
blocks.zh: 在这个配置下有两个模式是一致的. 首先,多样性是SpectRAG相对于每个基线最强的维度:平均胜64.1负于NaiveRAG,胜71.5负于HyDE,胜60.6负于Hybrid,胜55.0负于LightRAG。 这是一个检索器的标志,它将其证据分散在图中结构不同的区域,而不是集中在一个小的,多余的街区. 第二,比值的比值是:SpectRAG对HyDE和NaiveRAG决定性地战胜了所有四个维度,对HyDE和NaiveRAG的比值是整个比值,对LightRAG的比值甚至接近于全面性、赋权性和整体(49.7、48.4、48.7),而对多样性的比值(55.0)。 即使两个基于图表的系统在总质量上相匹配,SpectRAG更稠密的块状图仍继续提供更多,更少冗余的证据,符合其较高的边缘/节点比(RQ1).

blocks.en: To test whether this behavior depends on the exact signal weighting, we repeat the evaluation under a second, contrasting configuration that shifts weight away from raw semantic similarity and toward utility-question matching and entity structure: Semantic 0.150, Section 0.200, entity 0.250, adjacency 0.100, utility question 0.280, and citation 0.020. The results are reported in Table 10 .
blocks.zh: 为了检验这种行为是否取决于准确的信号权重,我们重复了第二下的评价,对比式的配置将权重从原始语义相似性转向了效用问题匹配和实体结构:语义0.150,0.20节,实体0.250,附位0.100,效用问题0.280,引文0.020。 调查结果见表10。

blocks.en: Table 10: Win rates (%) of baselines versus SpectRAG across four domains and four dimensions (signal configuration 2: semantic 0.150, section 0.200, entity 0.250, adjacency 0.100, utility question 0.280, citation 0.020)
blocks.zh: 表10:基线对SpectRAG在四个领域和四个维度的胜率(%)(符号配置2:语义0.150,第0.20节,实体0.250,辅助0.100,效用问题0.280,引文0.020)

blocks.en: Comparing the two configurations yields two findings. First, the diversity advantage is stable across both weightings : diversity remains SpectRAG’s strongest dimension against every baseline (60.0, 72.5, 58.8, 55.9), with margins that closely track configuration 1. Because the two weightings emphasize almost disjoint signal sets yet produce the same diversity ordering, the effect is a structural property of the denser chunk graph rather than an artifact of any single signal. Second, the utility-question-weighted configuration strengthens SpectRAG against the hardest baseline : against LightRAG, SpectRAG moves from winning only diversity (configuration 1) to additionally winning empowerment (51.2) and the overall verdict (51.2), losing only comprehensiveness by a narrow margin (49.4). The gains against the weaker baselines are preserved throughout. This indicates that anchoring retrieval on utility questions and entity structure, rather than surface semantic similarity, helps most precisely where the competition is strongest. Together, the two configurations bound SpectRAG’s qualitative behavior: its diversity and redundancy advantages are insensitive to the exact signal weighting. At the same time, its aggregate standing against LightRAG can be tuned from roughly even to a slight lead.
blocks.zh: 比较两个配置得出两个结论。 首先,在两种加权中,多样性优势是稳定的:多样性仍然是SpectRAG相对于每个基线(60.0、72.5、58.8、55.9)的最强维度,其边距则密切跟踪配置。 1. 由于两种加权都强调几乎不相连的信号集,但产生相同的多样性顺序,因此这种效应是较密集的块状图的结构属性,而不是任何单一信号的文物。 第二,效用问题加权配置加强了SpectRAG相对于最困难基线的优势:SpectRAG从只赢得多样性(配置1)到额外赢得赋权(51.2),以及总体判断(51.2),只以微弱的比值(49.4)失去全面性。 相对于较弱的基线而言,收益始终得到保持。 这表明,将检索定位在公用问题和实体结构上,而不是表面语义相似性上,最准确地有助于竞争最强的地方。 这两种配置共同束缚了SpectRAG的定性行为:其多样性和冗余优势对准确的信号权重不敏感. 同时,其与LightRAG相对立的总和可以从大约甚至导向微弱的导线.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: The experimental findings provide several observations about the behavior provide several observations about SpectRAG’s yield provide several observations about the behavior of SpectRAG in multi-hop and graph-structured retrieval settings. Overall, SpectRAG shows its strongest advantage when the task requires broad evidence recovery rather than only early precision in a ranked list. In the MultiHopRAG retrieval-ranking evaluation, SpectRAG achieves the highest overall recall and the highest Recall@10, indicating that the proposed graph expansion and spectral diffusion stages help recover a wider set of gold evidence. However, Hybrid retrieval obtains the best Recall@2, Recall@5, and MRR, suggesting that SpectRAG does not always place the first relevant evidence item earlier than strong lexical–dense baselines. This pattern is consistent with the design of SpectRAG: the method is not optimized solely for nearest-neighbor ranking, but for constructing a broader, more structurally useful candidate pool before final context selection.
blocks.zh: 实验结论对行为提供了几种观察,对SpectRAG的产量提供了几种观察,对SpectRAG在多跳和图结构检索环境中的行为提供了几种观察. 总体而言,SpectRAG在任务需要广泛的证据回收时,而不仅仅是在排名列表中的早期精确度时,显示出其最大的优势. 在MultiHopRAG检索排名评价中,SpectRAG实现了最高的整体召回和最高的召回@10,表示拟议的图扩展和光谱扩散阶段有助于回收更广泛的一组金证. 然而,混合检索获得最好的Recall@2、Recall@5和MRR,这表明SpectRAG并非总能比强力的Lexical - dense基线更早地放置第一个相关证据项目。 这种模式与SpectRAG的设计是一致的:该方法的优化并不仅仅是为了最近的邻居排名,而是为了在最终上下文选择前构建一个范围更广,结构上更有用的候选人池.

blocks.en: The generation-level results further indicate that improvements in retrieval coverage can translate into modest but consistent gains in answer accuracy. On MultiHopRAG, SpectRAG obtains the highest EM, F1, and answer-containment scores among the compared systems. The margin is not large, but it is consistent across all three generation metrics. This recommends that the final context selected by SpectRAG can provide useful evidence to the generator, especially when the answer depends on information distributed across multiple passages. Simultaneously, the relatively small generation margin highlights that better retrieval does not automatically guarantee substantially better generation. The LLM must correctly integrate the supplied evidence, follow the reasoning path, and avoid relying on irrelevant or weakly connected context.
blocks.zh: 生成层面的结果进一步表明,检索覆盖面的提高可转化为答案准确性方面微小但一致的提高。 在MultiHopRAG上,SpectRAG在比较系统中获得EM最高的F1和答录制分数. 差值并不大,但在所有三代度量中都是一致的。 这建议SpectRAG选择的最后上下文可以向生成者提供有用的证据,特别是当答案依赖于分布在多个段落的信息时. 同时,相对较少的生成比值突出表明,更好的检索并不能自动保证更好的生成。 LLM必须正确整合所提供的证据,遵循推理路径,避免依赖无关紧要或连接薄弱的上下文.

blocks.en: Based on the per-type analysis, it is evident that SpectRAG is especially useful in inference-type questions, scoring the highest EM scores amongst all the evaluated systems. These results confirm our hypothesis that graph-spectral representations are beneficial when the question requires connecting evidence pieces rather than finding a direct match. The results for the comparison and temporal questions are mixed, with LightRAG slightly better than SpectRAG. This implies that some question types could be helped more by other relational representations or different kinds of prompts. For null questions, SpectRAG attains the highest score among all evaluated systems, indicating that its spectral representation also supports reliable abstention and unanswerability detection rather than merely improving evidence retrieval. Beyond retrieval quality, SpectRAG additionally incurs a lower memory cost than competing graph-based RAG systems such as LightRAG, as it induces a markedly more compact graph representation over the same corpus, with substantially fewer nodes and edges. This reduction in structural complexity directly translates into lower storage and indexing overhead, indicating that the observed gains are achieved without a corresponding increase in resource consumption.
blocks.zh: 根据每类分析,SpectRAG显然对推论类问题特别有用,在所有被评价的系统中评分最高的EM分. 这些结果证实了我们的假设,即当问题需要连接证据片而不是找到直接匹配时,图谱表达是有利的. 比较结果和时间问题有好有坏,LightRAG略优于SpectRAG. 这意味着,有些问题类型可以通过其他关系表述或不同类型的提示得到更多的帮助。 对于无效的问题,SpectRAG在所有被评价的系统中获得最高分,表明其光谱表示也支持可靠的弃权和无法回答的检测,而不仅仅是改进证据检索。 除了检索质量外,SpectRAG还比LightRAG等相互竞争的基于图表的RAG系统产生较低的内存成本,因为它引致一个显著的更紧凑的图表在同一个元件上的体现,节点和边缘要少得多. 这种结构复杂性的降低直接转化为存储和索引管理费的降低,表明观察到的收益是在没有相应增加资源消耗的情况下取得的。

blocks.en: The pairwise LLM-judge evaluations across agriculture, CS, legal, and mix domains provide a complementary view of generation quality. Across two signal configurations, SpectRAG generally achieves favorable win rates against NaiveRAG, HyDE, and Hybrid baselines, especially in diversity and empowerment. The diversity gains are the most stable pattern: SpectRAG frequently receives higher diversity scores across domains and configurations. This is aligned with the method’s objective of reducing redundant evidence and selecting context from multiple graph-spectral regions. The results against LightRAG are more nuanced. SpectRAG is competitive and often stronger in diversity, but it does not consistently dominate LightRAG across all domains, particularly in the CS domain. This indicates that graph-spectral selection improves some aspects of answer quality, but its advantage depends on the corpus structure, baseline strength, and signal weighting.
blocks.zh: 跨农业、CS、法律领域和混合领域的双向LLM判断评价,提供了对生成质量的补充观点。 在整个两个信号配置中,SpectRAG普遍实现对NaiveRAG、HyDE和混合基线的有利赢率,特别是在多样性和赋权方面。 多样性收益是最稳定的模式:SpectRAG在域和配置上经常获得更高的多样性分数. 这符合该方法减少多余证据和从多个图谱区域选择上下文的目标。 对抗LightRAG的结果比较细微. SpectRAG具有竞争力,在多样性方面往往更强大,但是它并没有在所有领域,特别是在CS领域,始终主导LightRAG. 这表明图谱选择可以提高答题质量的某些方面,但其优点取决于字母结构、基线强度和信号权重。

blocks.en: The qualitative case study provides an interpretable example of this behavior. For the anomaly detection question, SpectRAG is preferred in comprehensiveness, diversity, empowerment, and overall quality. The judged explanation suggests that SpectRAG covers a wider set of methods, domains, evaluation strategies, and visualization tools, while LightRAG provides a more compact but less varied synthesis. Although this is only a single example, it illustrates the kind of context composition that SpectRAG is intended to support: a final answer grounded in multiple complementary evidence aspects rather than a narrow set of locally similar passages.
blocks.zh: 定性案例研究为这种行为提供了一个可解释的例子. 对于异常检测问题,SpectRAG在全面性、多样性、赋权和整体质量方面更受欢迎。 经判断的解释表明,SpectRAG涵盖更广泛的方法,领域,评价策略,以及可视化工具,而LightRAG则提供了比较紧凑但不太多样化的合成. 虽然这只是一个单一的例子,但它说明了SpectRAG打算支持的上下文构成类型:一个基于多个互补证据方面的最终答案,而不是一套狭隘的当地相似段落.

blocks.en: 6.1 Why Spectral Structure Helps
blocks.zh: 6.1 光谱结构为何有帮助

blocks.en: The results suggest that spectral graph structure is particularly useful when retrieval requires broad evidence coverage and relational coherence. Existing RAG pipelines exploit corpus structure only partially: purely embedding-based methods select chunks that are locally similar to the query without modeling the relationships among candidate chunks, whereas graph-based methods encode relations at the entity level and traverse them through local neighborhood expansion. In neither case is the collection of retrieval units treated as a global structure whose connectivity governs selection. Through a weighted chunk graph, SpectRAG instead incorporates semantic similarity, document adjacency, section hierarchy, entity co-occurrence, citation relations, and utility-question similarity as complementary signals of corpus structure.
blocks.zh: 结果表明,光谱图结构在检索需要广泛的证据覆盖面和关系一致性时特别有用。 现有的RAG管道只是部分利用实体结构:纯嵌入式方法选择与当地查询相似的块,而不模拟候选块之间的关系,而以图表为基础的方法在实体一级编码关系,并通过地方邻居的扩展来进行。 在这两种情况下,收集检索单元都不被视为一个全球结构,其连通性支配着选择。 通过加权块图,SpectRAG转而将语义相似性、文件的附属性、段级、实体共发生性、引用关系和效用问题相似性作为实体结构的补充信号。

blocks.en: The Laplacian spectral coordinates offer a compact description of such graph topology. Low-frequency spectral coordinates describe global connectivity patterns and communities in the graph, allowing detection of chunks belonging to the same group despite differences in their direct similarity. The use of the spectral coordinates in SpectRAG is crucial for the cluster-aware selection because it allows to avoid domination of one local neighborhood in the resulting context set.
blocks.zh: 拉普拉西亚光谱坐标对这种图表地形作了精确的描述。 低频光谱坐标在图中描述了全球连通模式和社区,可以检测属于同一组的块,尽管其直接相似性不同. SpectRAG中光谱坐标的使用对于群集感知选择至关重要,因为它可以避免在由此形成的上下文集中主宰一个本地街区.

blocks.en: Spectral diffusion also contributes to the retrieval process by propagating query relevance over the induced candidate subgraph. A chunk that is not highly similar to the query may still receive increased relevance if it is strongly connected to directly retrieved evidence. This mechanism is particularly important for bridge evidence, where an intermediate passage connects two otherwise disconnected pieces of information. The high overall recall and Recall@10 observed on MultiHopRAG are consistent with this behavior: SpectRAG appears to recover a broader evidence set, even when some of that evidence is not ranked at the very top.
blocks.zh: 光谱传播也通过在被引申的子图上传播查询关联性,促进了检索过程. 与查询不太相似的块,如果与直接检索的证据紧密相连,其相关性可能还会增加。 这种机制对桥梁证据特别重要,因为中间通道连接了两个原本断开的信息。 在MultiHopRAG上观察到的高总体召回和召回@10与这种行为一致: SpectRAG似乎恢复了更广泛的证据集,即使其中一些证据没有排在最前面。

blocks.en: 6.2 Practical Deployment in RAG Pipeline and Framework
blocks.zh: 6.2 RAG管道和框架中的实际部署

blocks.en: Figure 5: Example graph-view interface of the proposed SpectRAG framework. Nodes represent document chunks and edges represent weighted relation signals, including semantic similarity, section relations, entity overlap, adjacency, utility-question similarity, and citation links.
blocks.zh: 图5:拟议SpectRAG框架的图景界面实例。 节点代表文档块,边缘代表加权关系信号,包括语义相似性,节段关系,实体重叠性,附位性,效用问题相似性,以及引用链接.

blocks.en: In the current implementation, dense candidate seeding and utility-question retrieval are performed using exact flat inner-product search with FAISS IndexFlatIP . This choice avoids approximation error and makes the preliminary evaluation easier to interpret, since differences between systems are not caused by approximate nearest-neighbor indexing. For small and medium-sized experimental corpora, exact search is also practical and reproducible. In larger deployments, however, this component may become a bottleneck and can be replaced by approximate indexing methods without changing the downstream graph expansion, diffusion, and token-budget limit stages.
blocks.zh: 在目前的实施中,使用FAISS IndexFlatIP进行密集的候选种子和效用问题检索。 这种选择避免了近似误差,使初步评价更容易解释,因为不同系统之间的差异不是近似近邻索引造成的. 对于中小型实验蝎子,精确的搜索也是实用的,可以复制的. 然而,在较大的部署中,这个组成部分可能成为一个瓶颈,可以被大致的索引方法所取代,而不改变下游图的扩展、传播和象征性的预算限制阶段。

blocks.en: Most graph and spectral computations can be moved to the offline indexing stage. Chunk embeddings, graph construction, Laplacian computation, and spectral coordinates can be precomputed and cached. At query time, SpectRAG only needs to retrieve a candidate seed set, expand it through graph neighborhoods, construct the induced candidate subgraph, diffuse relevance within that subgraph, and select the final context. This separation between offline indexing and online retrieval makes the method practical for RAG systems where the corpus changes less frequently than the query stream.
blocks.zh: 大多数图和光谱计算可以移动到离线索引阶段. 春克嵌入,图建,拉普拉西安计算,光谱坐标可以预先计算和缓存. 在查询时间,SpectRAG只需要检索一个候选种子集,通过图表邻里扩展它,构建被引申的候选子图,在该子图中分散相关性,并选择最终上下文. 这种离线索引和在线检索的分离,使得该方法对RAG系统实用,因为与查询流相比,RAG系统变化较少.

blocks.en: In addition to the retrieval pipeline, SpectRAG includes a graph-view interface for inspecting the constructed chunk graph and its spectral organization. Fig. 5 shows an example visualization of the weighted chunk graph generated from an indexed document collection. In this view, nodes correspond to document chunks and edges correspond to relation signals used during graph construction, including semantic similarity, section-level relations, entity overlap, document adjacency, utility-question similarity, and citation links. The node layout provides an interpretable view of how chunks are organized in the graph, while edge colors indicate the dominant relation types connecting different parts of the corpus.
blocks.zh: 除了检索管道之外,SpectRAG还包括一个图景界面,用于检查已构建的块图及其光谱组织. 图5显示了从索引文件集生成的加权块图的可视化实例。 在此观点中,节点对应文档块和边缘对应图构造时使用的关系信号,包括语义相似性,节级关系,实体重叠性,文档毗连性,效用问题相似性,以及引用链接. 节点布局对图中块的排列方式提供了可解释的视角,边缘颜色则表示连接实体不同部分的主导关系类型.

These aspects are critical in establishing that the graph that is constructed properly captures the structure of the corpus before graph expansion, spectral relevance propagation, and budgeting of tokens for context selection are done. In actual RAG implementations, this visualization can help in identifying retrieval problems and graph sparsity.

blocks.en: 7 Limitations and Threats to Validity
blocks.zh: 7 对有效性的限制和威胁

blocks.en: Several limitations should be considered when interpreting the results of this study.
blocks.zh: 在解释本研究的结果时应考虑若干限制。

blocks.en: Retrieval–generation gap. Although SpectRAG improves retrieval coverage in several settings, retrieval gains do not always lead to proportional improvements in generated answers. The generator may fail to use retrieved evidence correctly, may ignore bridge passages, or may be sensitive to the ordering of the final context. This is especially important because the answer accuracy results show only modest improvements over strong baselines. Therefore, retrieval-level and generation-level metrics should be interpreted separately.
blocks.zh: 检索-生成差距。 虽然SpectRAG在多个场合中提高了检索覆盖面,但检索收益并不总是导致生成答案的成比例改进. 生成器可能无法正确使用所获取的证据,可能忽略桥梁通道,或者对最后上下文的顺序敏感. 这一点特别重要,因为答复准确性结果显示,相对于强有力的基线而言,改进不大。 因此,应分别解释检索级别和生成级别衡量标准。

blocks.en: Task-dependent performance. SpectRAG does not dominate all question types. The per-type evaluation shows strong performance on inference questions, but weaker or mixed results on comparison, temporal, and null questions. This indicates that graph-spectral retrieval is most beneficial when the task requires evidence connection and synthesis, but may be less effective when the task depends on precise temporal ordering, direct comparison, or abstention calibration.
blocks.zh: 取决于任务的表现。 SpectRAG并不主导所有的问题类型. 每类评价显示在推论问题上表现强劲,但在比较、时间和无效问题上结果较弱或喜忧参半。 这表明,当任务需要证据连接和合成时,图谱检索最为有益,但当任务依赖于精确的时间顺序,直接比较,或弃权校准时,则可能不太有效.

blocks.en: Signal-weight sensitivity. The two evaluated signal configurations indicate that performance can change depending on the relative weights assigned to semantic similarity, section hierarchy, entity overlap, adjacency, utility-question similarity, and citation links. While SpectRAG remains generally competitive across configurations, some domains and baselines respond differently to weight changes. This creates a threat to external validity because a configuration that works well for one corpus may not be optimal for another.
blocks.zh: 信号重量敏感. 两种被评价的信号配置表明,性能可以根据分配给语义相似性的相对权重,段级,实体重叠,附位,效用问题相似性,以及引用链接而改变. 虽然SpectRAG在各种配置方面仍然普遍具有竞争力,但一些域和基线对重量变化的反应不同。 这对外部有效性造成威胁,因为一种组合对一种生物体有效,对另一种生物体可能不是最佳配置。

blocks.en: Chunking sensitivity. The method is evaluated under token-based chunking configurations, including shorter and longer chunk granularities. Chunk size and overlap affect graph topology, candidate retrieval, redundancy, and the amount of local context available in each selected unit. Larger chunks preserve more local context but may reduce the benefit of graph-based composition. Therefore, chunking should be treated as an experimental variable rather than a fixed preprocessing choice.
blocks.zh: 弹簧敏感. 该方法在以符号为基础的块状配置下进行评估,包括较短和更长的块状颗粒。 Chunk 大小和重叠会影响图表地形,候选检索,冗余,以及每个选定单位可用的本地上下文的数量. 较大块保留了更多的本地环境,但可能减少以图表为基础的组成的好处。 因此,应将块块作为实验变量而不是固定的预处理选择。

blocks.en: Computational scalability. The current implementation uses exact brute-force inner-product search through FAISS IndexFlatIP for both chunk embedding retrieval and utility-question retrieval. This avoids approximation error but has higher query-time cost than approximate nearest-neighbor indexing. In addition, spectral computation over large graphs can be expensive. Practical large-scale deployments may require sparse graph construction, approximate eigensolvers, graph coarsening, caching, or approximate vector indexes.
blocks.zh: 计算可伸缩性. 目前的执行情况是通过FAISS IndexFlatIP进行精确的野蛮内在产品搜索,既用于块嵌入检索,也用于公用问题检索。 这避免了近似错误,但查询时间成本高于近似近邻索引. 此外,在大图上进行光谱计算可能很昂贵. 实际的大规模部署可能需要稀疏的图表构造、大约的eigensolvers、图的折合、缓存或大约矢量指数。

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: This paper introduced SpectRAG, a spectral graph-augmented retrieval framework for constructing diverse, connected, and evidence-complete context sets in retrieval-augmented generation. The central motivation of the work is that standard dense retrieval is effective for identifying passages that are individually similar to a query, but it does not explicitly optimize the collective utility of the retrieved context. This limitation becomes more important in multi-hop and cross-document settings, where the answer may depend on evidence distributed across several passages, documents, or structural relations.
blocks.zh: 本文介绍了SpectRAG,这是一个光谱图增强检索框架,用于在检索-增强生成中构建多样、连接和完整的上下文集。 工作的核心动机是标准密集检索对于识别单独与查询相似的段落是有效的,但它并没有明确地优化检索上下文的集体用途. 这种限制在多跳和跨文件设置中变得更加重要,在这种设置中,答案可能取决于在若干段落、文件或结构关系中分发的证据。

blocks.en: SpectRAG addresses this problem by combining dense candidate seeding, weighted chunk graph construction, graph neighborhood expansion, spectral relevance propagation, and token-budgeted final context selection. Rather than replacing dense retrieval, the proposed framework uses it as a high-recall entry point and then applies graph-spectral signals to recover supporting evidence, reduce redundant context, and improve structural coherence. The final context is assembled under a token budget, allowing the system to adapt the number of selected chunks according to evidence length and available context-window capacity.
blocks.zh: SpectRAG通过将密集的候选种子、加权块图构建、图表邻里扩展、光谱相关性传播和象征性预算的最后背景选择结合起来来解决这一问题。 拟议的框架与其取代密集检索,不如将其作为高调的切入点,然后应用图谱信号来恢复辅助证据,减少冗余上下文,提高结构一致性. 最后的上下文是在象征性预算下组装的,使系统能够根据证据长度和可用的上下文窗口能力来调整选定块的数量.

blocks.en: The experimental results show that SpectRAG is most beneficial when retrieval requires broad evidence recovery and relational reasoning. On MultiHopRAG, SpectRAG achieves the highest overall recall and Recall@10, indicating that graph expansion and spectral propagation help recover a wider set of relevant evidence. In generation-level evaluation, SpectRAG obtains the strongest EM, F1, and answer-containment scores among the compared systems, although the margins remain moderate. These results suggest that improved evidence coverage can support better generation, but also confirm that retrieval gains do not automatically translate into large answer-quality gains unless the generator can effectively use the selected evidence.
blocks.zh: 实验结果表明,SpectRAG在检索需要广泛的证据恢复和关系推理时最为有益. 在MultiHopRAG上,SpectRAG实现了最高的总体召回和召回@10,表明图的扩展和光谱传播有助于恢复更广泛的相关证据。 在生成级评价中,SpectRAG在比较系统中获得了最强的EM,F1和答录率分数,尽管差值仍然中等. 这些结果表明,提高证据覆盖面可以支持更好的生成,但也证实,除非生成者能够有效利用选定的证据,检索收益不会自动转化为高答质量收益。

blocks.en: SpectRAG also turns out to be an especially strong solution for inference problems and often helps diversify judgments in LLM-based pairwise evaluations of diversity. In the vast majority of domains and signal combinations, SpectRAG outperforms the NaiveRAG, HyDE, and Hybrid baselines across diversity, empowerment, and total performance metrics. Comparing the results of SpectRAG with those of LightRAG reveals some interesting conclusions: graph-spectral context selection performs better than the alternative in some cases but not in others. However, it retains an overall advantage in aggregate. This balanced result is valuable. since the proposed approach ought not to be construed as a wholesale improvement over prevailing retrieval strategies, but rather as a complementary method, warranted specifically in settings where evidence diversity and connectivity must be preserved.
blocks.zh: SpectRAG也证明是推论问题的一个特别有力的解决办法,并经常有助于对基于LLM的双向多样性评价的判断多样化。 在绝大多数领域和信号组合中,SpectRAG超越了NaiveRAG、HyDE和跨越多样性、赋权和总性能衡量尺度的混合基线。 将SpectRAG的结果与LightRAG的结果相比较,可以得出一些有趣的结论:图谱上下文选择的成绩有时优于其他选择,但有时则不然。 然而,它总体上保持了优势。 这种平衡的结果是有价值的。 由于拟议办法不应被理解为比现行检索战略大有改进,而应理解为一种补充方法,在必须保留证据多样性和连通性的情况下,这是特别必要的。

blocks.en: Overall, the findings support the main hypothesis of this work: graph-spectral structure can provide useful retrieval signals beyond local vector similarity. By representing chunks as nodes in a weighted graph and leveraging spectral structure during candidate expansion, relevance propagation, and token-budgeted context assembly, SpectRAG offers a principled approach to moving from independent passage ranking to graph-aware context construction. Future work should extend the evaluation to larger corpora and additional domains, conduct human preference studies, develop stronger graph-enhanced baselines, and explore scalable indexing variants. Further investigation is also needed to optimize signal weights, improve temporal and comparative reasoning, and examine how context ordering affects LLMs’ ability to exploit graph-selected evidence.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,研究结果支持了这项工作的主要假设:图谱结构可以提供超出局部矢量相似性的有用的检索信号. SpectRAG在加权图中将块作为节点,并在候选人扩展、相关传播和象征性预算的上下文组装期间利用光谱结构,为从独立通道排名转向图感上下文构造提供了一个原则性办法。 今后的工作应当将评价扩大到更大的公司和更多的领域,进行人类偏好研究,制定更强有力的图表强化基线,并探索可扩展的索引变体。 还需要进一步调查,以优化信号权重,改善时间和比较推理,并审查背景命令如何影响LLMs利用图选证据的能力。
